Step:  
51 weeks = 357 days.  
Add 1 more day → total 358 days.  
1796 is a leap year (divisible by 4, and 1796 is after 1752 but before exceptions for century years not divisible by 400 start in 1800).  
From 1795-02-25:  
Days in 1795 after Feb 25 = (28–25) + 31+30+31+30+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 3 + 306 = 309 days.  
Remaining days in 358 total = 358 – 309 = 49 days into 1796.  
Jan 1796 = 31 days, so 49 – 31 = 18 days into Feb 1796.  
Feb 1796 has 29 days (leap year), so 1796-02-18.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1796-02-18
